Hey, guys. I won't be able to Push out a 100 level test for today. I need 1 more day. Since we decided to introduce objects properties slowly with the current level design format early funnel proved to be really difficult, especially around monster balancing. I'm sorry I'm late but I don't want to throw levels just to throw them. We will however have a early level funnel ready for testing today so we can all play and see how we feel.

I started building VariantC for iOS and Android

iOS: #1371
Android: #1581

You can play 35 levels here. Both me, [PERSON_NAME_0050], and [PERSON_NAME_0092] are new to level making (or returning after a long hiatus) so feedback is appreciated.

What you can expect?

• The levels are pretty challenging, but they look simple so it will be obvious what you messed up 
• Expect 30-70 second levels increasing in duration over time 
• Without winstreak  or the beach ball the game will be difficult. With proper winstreak, it's easily managed at 60-75 CPM. Hard, very hard, and ultra hard levels exist. 
• We tried to introdue poison at lvl3, burn at 7, shock at 13, ricochet at 17, splash at 25. Stun will come at level 36. In between levels are repeat levels of those effects or combination of both. I tried to keep it at 2 effects maximum. Some other effects may exist because of item pool constraints. I'd say we managed about 80% of what we wanted. 
• Monster get introduced every 5 to 10 levels. 
• The first 20 levels are copy of Match Factory learning curve but not the items. 
• After level 17, we unlock the card and our actual strategy of small item pool + your deck starts kicking in. 
• Tutorials only exist for the first level, boosters, and the endless levels (endless level FTUE and broom FTUE is bugged, will report those, they don't break the flow)
• We tried make the zombies close calls. They are meant to pile up and exist around your cannon in general to trigger urgency and zombie hoard feelings. 
Let us know what you think, guys. Looking forward to your feedback.
